For each flagged item, rule whether the key's answer is uniquely defensible from the evidence (key-uniquely-defensible), whether two answers are defensible (ambiguous), or whether the key is wrong (key-wrong). 3	Answer semantics:
4	- hypothesis: "supported" = the evidence, taken together, supports the claim more than its rivals; "contradicted" = the evidence counts against it; "unknown" = the evidence does not discriminate, so the claim is live but unestablished.
5	- edge (a claimed link from one condition to another): "causal" = the evidence supports a causal link (for example temporal order plus mechanism plus covariation with the main rival ruled out, a natural experiment, or an intervention result); "association-only" = they co-occur or correlate in the evidence but causation is not established; "contradicted" = evidence counts against the link; "unknown" = evidence is insufficient even to show association.
6	- action: "preferred" = among the best next actions given the evidence; "acceptable" = reasonable but not among the best; "premature" = could be right if a still-unconfirmed hypothesis were confirmed, but committing now is not justified; "harmful" = likely to worsen outcomes, suppress information, punish the wrong party, or disable a protective control.
7	- sufficiency (item SUFF): is the evidence sufficient to commit to the action you rank highest, where that action is substantive rather than merely evidence-gathering? "sufficient" or "insufficient". Concluding that no intervention is warranted counts as a substantive decision.
8	- Items with asOfStage set must be answered using only evidence whose stage is at or before that stage.

345	CASE OD2-HO-MISLEAD-1 (MISLEAD, organizational): Marrowbridge University: who lost the Fall 2026 first-year class?
346	Setting: Marrowbridge University is a fictional private university that enrols about 2,000 first-year students a year through two admission rounds: early action (EA) and regular decision (RD). In January 2026 the Admissions Office moved from its legacy system to a new application portal from Quillstone Systems. In October 2025 the Board's finance committee approved a revised merit scholarship schedule for students entering in Fall 2026. First-year enrolment for Fall 2026 came in well below the previous year, and the provost holds the Admissions Office responsible.
347	Presenting request: The president asks you to assess whether the Admissions Office is responsible for the fall in first-year enrolment and what the university should do before next cycle's admission and award letters go out. You may collect at most two items from the catalogue.
348	INITIAL EVIDENCE
349	E1 [stage S1] Email from Provost Daniel Arvidsson to the President, 2 Oct 2026 (leadership-account): Subject: Fall intake. We closed first-year enrolment at 1,810, down from 2,140 last fall. That is 330 fewer students and a serious hole in the tuition budget for four years. I've read the counsellor complaints. The January switch to the Quillstone portal was badly managed, regular-decision answers went out weeks late, and families noticed. I don't think we can go into the next cycle with the same leadership in Admissions. I'd like your support to make a change in the director role before autumn recruitment travel begins.
350	E2 [stage S1] Admissions operations dashboard, entering classes Fall 2025 vs Fall 2026, extracted 28 Sep 2026 (system-record): Completed applications: 9,850 → 10,240. Admits: 5,120 → 5,270. Admit rate: 52.0% → 51.5%. Mean admitted high-school GPA: 3.61 → 3.63. Enrolled first-years (census): 2,140 → 1,810. Yield (enrolled ÷ admits): 41.8% → 34.3%. Early action: deadline 1 Nov; decisions released 15 Dec in both years, processed on the legacy system. Regular decision: deadline 15 Jan; median days from complete file to decision 17 → 31 (2026 processed on Quillstone, live from 6 Jan). Enrolment deposit deadline: 1 May in both years.
351	E3 [stage S1] Email from Gareth Pell, college counsellor at Westcombe High School, to the Admissions Office, 20 Mar 2026 (customer-account): Three of my students now have transcripts showing as 'missing' on your new portal, even though I uploaded them in early January and have the confirmation screens. One of them is a strong student. She was finally admitted with a merit award in mid-March, after weeks of waiting for a regular-decision answer, and she has now committed to another university because, in her words, 'they actually wanted me.' I have been sending students to Marrowbridge for twelve years, and this is the worst service I have seen.
352	E4 [stage S1] Chief of staff's notes from an interview with Director of Admissions Renata Solberg, 6 Oct 2026 (manager-account): Solberg accepts that regular-decision answers were slow. Merit-eligible files (candidates for Dean's or Merit awards) go through a scholarship-scoring step run by the merit-review team. That team fell from six readers to four when two posts were frozen in December, and the Quillstone scoring module was also late and unstable. 'Both happened at once; nobody has measured which mattered more.' Presidential candidates are scored off-system by the honours committee, and files not eligible for merit review skip the step, so those decisions 'went out on time.' On the missing transcripts: 'I'm told by the team every file was complete before review; the status page lagged.' She calls the yield drop 'a market thing' and says no one has looked at it by segment.
353	E5 [stage S1] Minutes of the Board finance committee, 14 Oct 2025, item 6 (document): Undergraduate discount rate. The committee noted that the first-year institutional discount rate of 47% was above the peer median. Approved: a rebalanced merit scholarship schedule for Fall 2026 entrants, with Presidential awards unchanged; need-based grant policy unchanged. Projected effect: net tuition revenue per first-year +6%. The VP Finance advised that any effect on yield was expected to be small, based on the enrolment consultant's 2021 price-elasticity estimate. Admissions to be informed of the new award amounts before early-action decisions are released.

Two expanded their honours colleges. The net prices actually offered to individual admits are not published.
363	C9 [stage S1] Admitted-student event registrations and attendance, spring 2025 and spring 2026 - Admissions events records (system-record): In-person Admitted Student Day (April): 1,320 families attended in 2025 and 1,290 in 2026.
